_about: Lightning comparison of 2026-10-31: the CUDA cases on a Tesla T4 (lightning-comparison-run1.log, GPUlayer with device prefetch and cuDNN autotuning on, the defaults); the DDP CPU case on an n1-standard-8 without GPU (../2026-10-31-gcp-ddp-cpu/). Read by scripts/make_perf_charts.py.

training_vs_lightning.hardware: GCP n1-standard-8 + 1x Tesla T4 (driver 580.178.04), Ubuntu 22.04, Python 3.12, torch 2.15.0 (cuDNN 9.26), Lightning 2.6.6; Spot VM
training_vs_lightning.method: benchmarks/lightning_comparison: 100 and 600 steps, 3 runs each in fresh processes, one at a time; ms/step = (median 600 - median 100) / 500; start-up = median 100-step wall - 100 x step
